$comment: What a change owes, by the paths it touches. `pnpm verify plan` matches a diff against `paths` (globs) or, for a path-filtered workflow, against that workflow's own `on.pull_request.paths` (`pathsFrom`), so this map and CI cannot disagree (obligations.test.mjs). `proof` names what discharges an owed item in `pnpm verify status`: a passing result for this commit whose `proves` lists it.

obligations.why: AGENTS.md, Checks Before a PR: typecheck, lint, the affected packages' tests and formatting pass
Queries, migrations and leases are proved only against a real, migrated Postgres; without one the `*.db.test.ts` suites skip
Boat image custody: a refused build, a retry after quarantine, retention. The catalog and retention suites skip without their own database and the staged runtime bundle
The Effect runtime over a real sealantd; its suite skips when no daemon binary is present
Boat custody, model-checked: a VM is never forgotten while Boat may hold it, and a full key check leaves nothing behind (the boat-custody skill)
Boat lifecycle end to end against a fake Boat provider: one VM per run, FINAL before deletion, nothing left owned
Real Boat provisioning, proxy and billing cannot be proved locally; the harness fakes the provider

owes.what: a live Boat launch, stop and resume on the provider (packages/workspaces/scripts/boat-live-check.ts)

obligations.why: AGENTS.md: every UI change is screenshotted for its PR, and a screen is verified only once someone has looked at it

owes.command: the verify skill: start the stack
the verify skill: drive it and take screenshots

obligations.why: The verify skill: a change to the API or SDK is proved by using it, beyond its tests

owes.command: the verify skill: start the stack
